description: REGNA-ROU is Uruguay's national active geodetic network of continuously operating GNSS stations, run by the Instituto Geográfico Militar (formerly the Servicio Geográfico Militar). The IGM service page read on 2026-09-29 says the institute offers free real-time differential correction (DGNSS and RTK through an NTRIP caster at rtk.igm.gub.uy port 2101, after user registration) and post-processing data: current-year observation files on an anonymous FTP server (pp.igm.gub.uy) and historical files on an SFTP server with a published guest login, plus official station coordinates and a station data page. The network's stations are part of SIRGAS-CON. Coverage: national, Uruguay. Format and access: free; RINEX observation files by FTP and SFTP, real-time corrections by NTRIP with registration. Licence: not stated. Caveats: the page asks users to register to receive maintenance notices; web browsers such as Chrome no longer open FTP links, so an FTP client is needed; the earlier address sgm.gub.uy no longer answers. Simulation uses: positioning reference for asset surveys and for studies of GNSS dependency and disruption in infrastructure operations. Related records: compare with Brazil's RBMC (data-ibge-rbmc-gnss-network) and the SIRGAS continuous network (data-sirgas-continuous-gnss-network).
